faqs.a:
A regular employee who has worked for the city for a minimum of seven consecutive
               years and is considered to be in good standing shall have the opportunity to take
               up to three months of time for the purpose of rejuvenation or the pursuit of a personal
               objective or aspiration. An employee may take sabbatical leave only once every seven
               years. The city manager may establish administrative procedures for the administration
               of this benefit.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
